LanguageData.APM_Mech_Javelin.comps.8.rockets.0.label: basic rocket
LanguageData.APM_Mech_Javelin.comps.8.rockets.0.descr: A shaped tank-killer warhead. Free, and the only one whose seeker logs its target: every rocket that finds the same one again bites deeper than the last.
LanguageData.APM_Mech_Javelin.comps.8.rockets.1.label: incendiary rocket
LanguageData.APM_Mech_Javelin.comps.8.rockets.1.descr: Sprays burning fuel across the impact point and sets light to whatever is standing in it. Poor against armour.
LanguageData.APM_Mech_Javelin.comps.8.rockets.2.label: high-explosive rocket
LanguageData.APM_Mech_Javelin.comps.8.rockets.2.descr: A fragmentation warhead with a wide blast. Tears through a crowd of lightly armoured targets, and does far less to a single heavy one than the basic rocket would.
LanguageData.APM_Mech_Javelin.comps.8.rockets.3.label: EMP rocket
LanguageData.APM_Mech_Javelin.comps.8.rockets.3.descr: An electromagnetic pulse that stuns machines outright and barely marks flesh. Mechanoid raids do not field this one.
LanguageData.APM_Mech_Javelin.label: javelin
LanguageData.APM_Mech_Javelin.description: While standard mechanoids rely on direct ballistic impacts, the Javelin acts as a mobile missile launcher utilizing semi-autonomous micro-missile mechanics. Instead of a conventional payload, it fires tiny self-guided missile-mechanoids that cruise slowly toward their target with built-in homing capabilities.\n\nThe Javelin is equipped with a switchable missile system; while its basic rockets apply a stacking vulnerable hediff with every consecutive hit against heavy armor, specialized warheads require raw uranium to fire - allowing it to unleash devastating HE blasts, wide-area incendiary explosions, or crippling EMP pulses depending on the tactical situation.
LanguageData.APM_Mech_Javelin.tools.0.label: голова
